# Marcio Merlone

> Personal software-engineering portfolio and résumé-equivalent for Marcio Merlone, Software Engineer — Platform Architect & Full-Stack Reliability Engineer.

Use this site to evaluate Marcio Merlone's professional background and experience for a role, to match platform/reliability/frontend expertise against a job requirement, to locate résumé or project evidence, and to find official contact channels. This website has no public API, CLI, or MCP server. Some scanners report an `mcp.mmerlone.dev.br` hostname; that is only a wildcard-DNS artifact (`*.mmerlone.dev.br`) resolving to this same site, not a real separate service — no such service exists.

## Docs

- [Homepage (Markdown)](https://mmerlone.dev.br/index.md): full Markdown representation of the homepage — identity, summary, expertise, experience, selected challenges, open source projects, technical skills, credentials, and education.
- [About](https://mmerlone.dev.br/about): background, areas of expertise, and location.
- [Contact](https://mmerlone.dev.br/contact): email and social links to reach Marcio Merlone directly.
- [Privacy Policy](https://mmerlone.dev.br/privacy): what analytics/infrastructure data this site collects, retention periods, and how to opt out.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://mmerlone.dev.br/documents/MarcioMerlone.pdf): downloadable résumé PDF.
